post.description: Always 202 for well-formed input, whether or not the email is registered.
Sign out everywhere, including the current device.

Verify the uploaded bytes and register the photo. Returns it as `ready` or `rejected`
(with `error_code`); `upload_incomplete` (409) if the bytes have not arrived yet.
Safe to repeat.

Register a photo and get a presigned PUT for its bytes. Calling again with the same
`client_upload_id` returns the same photo with a fresh URL while it is pending.

Verify the uploaded recording (size, SHA-256, container, codec, real duration).
Returns it as `ready` or `rejected` (with `error_code`); `upload_incomplete` (409) if
the bytes have not arrived yet. Safe to repeat.

Register a recording and get a presigned PUT for its bytes. Calling again with the
